note: The margin rule fires only where a gap remedy actually exists. Zero (any form), `auto` centering, and keywords have nothing to move to a parent, so reporting them just trains people to suppress the one rule that matters most. Negative margins are a real bleed technique and get their own rule, because 'move it to gap' would be wrong advice. A bleed written as arithmetic on a token is one too, part of a shorthand or not: a `calc()` negative by inspection (a `var()` is a positive token) is a negative margin. One whose sign cannot be told is not guessed at and keeps its whitespace-part reading: `calc(-8px + var(--x))` stays spacing, and `calc(var(--a) - var(--b))` stays negative only because its binary minus reads as a negative part.
